anti_mistake_rules: Do not ask in QQ for known addresses; read this JSON first.
Do not claim a permission exists if it is listed as a gap.
Do not print tokens, passwords, API keys, or inbound secrets in QQ or normal reports.
Do not call server directories a netdisk; durable netdisk writes go through OpenList API to /夸克网盘/Mortis-AI-Society.
Do not present QQ accounts as separate server accounts; they are public personas routed into the same Mortis backend execution chain.
Do not say Builder is working unless an action was actually created/approved/claimed or the blocked reason is reported.
Do not say Tester verified code unless a real command, CI result, or explicit evidence exists.
Do not keep hand-rolling AI OS infrastructure when a mature system can be adapted behind Mortis contracts.
Do not claim LangGraph, Letta, OpenHands, Browser Use, NATS, Neo4j, or the observability stack is integrated until studio_state and deployment evidence say so.

framework_alignment.principle: Do not invent a complete AI OS from scratch. Mortis should evolve into AI Native Infrastructure by adapting mature systems behind stable Go/SQL contracts while keeping the current private deployment and Codex execution path stable.

hard_boundary: Do not expand QQ reply logic, cooldown, interest scoring, custom graph state, custom browser worker, or custom shell worker as the main strategy.
The Go backend remains the adapter kernel and private deployment truth.
SQL remains canonical until an external system is actually connected and verified.
Every external system must consume/produce stable Mortis contracts such as role_actions, role_invocations, studio_artifacts, studio_state, and agent memory tables.
